rv.q: A city loved by its people – and if this superb musical is anything to go by, with very good reason.
Her writing and Richard Hawley's protean music are gorgeously balanced.
This is a mega-budget muddle posing as a state-of-the-nation musical.

cn.t: Critics split sharply on this Sheffield-set musical triptych spanning decades in a council estate flat. Most praise Bush's evocative storytelling and emotional power, though one dismisses it as heavy-handed political propaganda.
